title: mantisalca salmantica
intro: Mantisalca salmantica, commonly known as Salmander or Salmantica, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health issues, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Mantisalca salmantica include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant has been used therapeutically to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant effects.
